# API reference: SCNodeClass

<!-- Generated by `make docs-api` from config/crd/bases; do not edit. -->

Every field of the `SCNodeClass` custom resource, as the API server accepts it
(generated from the CRD). One SCNodeClass holds the node definition shared by
every vendor and a typed block per vendor under `spec.vendors`; the
selector and ranking fields of `spec.selections` are those of
sc-karpenter-nodepool (module sc-keeper-go, package selection/api). The design
behind the fields is in the [decision records](../explanation/DECISIONS.md)
(ADR-014, ADR-018 and ADR-020).

Units: memory and disk sizes are Kubernetes quantities (`64Gi`) unless a field
name says otherwise, prices are USD per hour (decimal strings such as
`"0.40"`), durations are strings such as `24h`, every other number is a
plain number.

## Resource

| | |
|---|---|
| apiVersion | `scarpenter.sparecores.com/v1alpha1` |
| kind | `SCNodeClass` |
| scope | Cluster |
| resource | `scnodeclasses` |
| subresources | `status` |
| printer columns | Vendors, Ready, Age |

SCNodeClass is the node definition SCarpenter launches nodes from: shared settings plus a block per vendor.

## spec

### `spec`

SCNodeClassSpec is the node definition shared by every vendor, plus a typed block per vendor (ADR-014). Which vendor a NodeClaim uses is chosen by the NodePool's scarpenter.sparecores.com/vendor requirement.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `butane` | [object](#specbutane) |  | butane references extra Butane configuration merged into every node's Ignition. |
| `catalog` | [object](#speccatalog) |  | catalog configures the instance type catalog built from Keeper. |
| `flatcar` (required) | [object](#specflatcar) |  | flatcar selects the Flatcar Container Linux release nodes boot. |
| `kubelet` | [object](#speckubelet) | `{}` | kubelet configures the kubelet and the node capacity the scheduler assumes. |
| `kubernetes` (required) | [object](#speckubernetes) |  | kubernetes selects the Kubernetes release (a sysext-bakery release) nodes run. |
| `metrics` | map of [object](#specmetrics) |  | metrics define benchmark metric labels (metric-&lt;name&gt;, -pct and -per-usd) on instance types and offerings. |
| `network` (required) | [object](#specnetwork) |  | network is the node bootstrap network template (how nodes reach the control plane). |
| `networking` | [object](#specnetworking) | `{}` | networking is the generic network setting, identical in meaning on every vendor; vendor blocks may override it. |
| `poweroffAfter` | string |  | poweroffAfter powers a node off after this long: a fail-safe against instances that outlive their NodeClaim. Pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(s\|m\|h))+$`. |
| `pricing` | [object](#specpricing) | `{}` | pricing configures how offerings are priced. |
| `profiles` | [object](#specprofiles) | `{}` | profiles are named, explicit, vendor-native setups that workloads pick by name through labels. |
| `selections` | map of [object](#specselections) |  | selections define selection profiles: sc-karpenter-nodepool's selector and ranking, evaluated on every catalog refresh. Instance types carry the label selection=&lt;name&gt; for each profile they belong to. |
| `sysexts` | array of [object](#specsysexts) |  | sysexts lists extra systemd sysexts installed on every node. At most 16 items. |
| `tags` | map of string values |  | tags are added to every vendor resource SCarpenter creates (tags or labels, as the vendor calls them). Rule: tag keys in the scarpenter.sparecores.com domain are reserved (`self.all(k, !k.startsWith('scarpenter.sparecores.com/'))`). |
| `vendors` (required) | [object](#specvendors) |  | vendors has one block per vendor; a vendor is enabled for this SCNodeClass by having a block. |

### `spec.catalog`

catalog configures the instance type catalog built from Keeper.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpuFlagLabels` | array of string |  | cpuFlagLabels are the CPU flags that get a cpu-flag-&lt;flag&gt; label on instance types. The set is closed: the labels are registered with Karpenter core at start-up, so only this curated list of flags useful for workload selection (names as in Keeper's cpu_flags, Linux /proc/cpuinfo spelling) is accepted. Defaults to avx2, avx512f, amx_tile and sha_ni. One of `avx`, `avx2`, `avx512f`, `avx512bw`, `avx512vl`, `avx512dq`, `avx512cd`, `avx512_vnni`, `avx512_bf16`, `avx512_fp16`, `avx512vbmi`, `avx512ifma`, `avx_vnni`, `amx_tile`, `amx_bf16`, `amx_int8`, `sha_ni`, `aes`, `vaes`, `gfni`, `pclmulqdq`, `bmi2`, `fma`, `sse4_2`, `asimd`, `sve`, `sve2`, `sha2`, `sha3`. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.flatcar`

flatcar selects the Flatcar Container Linux release nodes boot.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | string | `"stable"` | channel of the release. One of `stable`, `beta`, `alpha`, `lts`. |
| `version` (required) | string |  | version is the pinned release, e.g. 4757.2.3. Changing it drifts nodes. Pattern `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`. |

### `spec.kubelet`

kubelet configures the kubelet and the node capacity the scheduler assumes.

Validation: systemReserved keys must be cpu, memory, ephemeral-storage or pid (`!has(self.systemReserved) \|\| self.systemReserved.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage', 'pid'])`).

Validation: kubeReserved keys must be cpu, memory, ephemeral-storage or pid (`!has(self.kubeReserved) \|\| self.kubeReserved.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage', 'pid'])`).

Validation: evictionHard keys must be eviction signals (`!has(self.evictionHard) \|\| self.evictionHard.all(k, k in ['memory.available', 'nodefs.available', 'nodefs.inodesFree', 'imagefs.available', 'imagefs.inodesFree', 'pid.available'])`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evictionHard` | map of string values |  | evictionHard thresholds, e.g. memory.available: 100Mi. |
| `kubeReserved` | map of string values |  | kubeReserved overrides the computed resources reserved for Kubernetes daemons. |
| `maxPods` | integer (int32) | `110` | maxPods is the maximum number of Pods per node. Minimum 1. Maximum 1000. |
| `systemReserved` | map of string values |  | systemReserved resources for system daemons. |
| `vmMemoryOverheadPercent` | number | `7.5` | vmMemoryOverheadPercent is the share of the catalog memory a VM does not offer to the guest, subtracted from the instance type's capacity. Minimum 0. Maximum 50. |

### `spec.metrics.*`

Metric defines a benchmark metric: a benchmark or a workload profile, optionally normalised per vCPU. Exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile is set.

Validation: set exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile (`has(self.benchmark) != has(self.workloadProfile)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `benchmark` | [object](#specmetricsbenchmark) |  | benchmark identifies a Spare Cores benchmark (id and config). |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize is applied to the score before the labels are computed. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`. |
| `scale` | integer (int32) | `1` | scale multiplies the score before it is rounded to the integer label value, to keep precision (e.g. 100). Minimum 1. Maximum 1e+06. |
| `workloadProfile` | string |  | workloadProfile is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |

### `spec.metrics.*.benchmark`

benchmark identifies a Spare Cores benchmark (id and config).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |

### `spec.network`

network is the node bootstrap network template (how nodes reach the control plane).

Validation: network.tailscale is required with template tailscale and invalid otherwise (`self.template == 'tailscale' ? has(self.tailscale) : !has(self.tailscale)`).

Validation: network.custom is required with template custom and invalid otherwise (`self.template == 'custom' ? has(self.custom) : !has(self.custom)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `custom` | [object](#specnetworkcustom) |  | custom configures the custom template. |
| `tailscale` | [object](#specnetworktailscale) |  | tailscale configures the tailscale template. |
| `template` (required) | string |  | template: tailscale joins nodes through a tailnet, direct has nodes reach the API server directly, custom renders your own Butane template. One of `tailscale`, `direct`, `custom`. |

### `spec.networking`

networking is the generic network setting, identical in meaning on every vendor; vendor blocks may override it.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound lists the allowed inbound traffic. Without rules everything inbound is denied (a deny firewall is attached where the vendor default is open). |
| `isolation` | string | `"run"` | isolation decides who may reach a node privately: none, the nodes of the SCNodeClass, or only the nodes of the same run (placement group run key). One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean | `true` | publicIPv4 gives nodes a public IPv4 address. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean | `false` | publicIPv6 gives nodes a public IPv6 address. |

### `spec.networking.inbound`

inbound lists the allowed inbound traffic. Without rules everything inbound is denied (a deny firewall is attached where the vendor default is open).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

### `spec.profiles.placement.*.aws.placementGroup`

placementGroup is the placement construct nodes join; it needs a run key (label placement-group) to be created per run.

Validation: set exactly one of strategy and use (`has(self.strategy) != has(self.use)`).

Validation: partitionCount is only valid with strategy partition (`!has(self.partitionCount) \|\| (has(self.strategy) && self.strategy == 'partition')`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `partitionCount` | integer (int32) |  | partitionCount is the number of partitions (strategy partition). Minimum 1. Maximum 7. |
| `strategy` | string |  | strategy of the placement groups SCarpenter creates. One of `cluster`, `partition`, `spread`. |
| `use` | [object](#specprofilesplacementawsplacementgroupuse) |  | use references an existing placement group, which is never modified or deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims. |

### `spec.profiles.placement.*.aws.placementGroup.use`

use references an existing placement group, which is never modified or deleted; the run key then only separates NodeClaims.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*`

StorageProfile is a named storage setup, in the vendor's own terms, for each vendor it applies to. On a vendor without a block the profile does not exist.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aws` | [object](#specprofilesstorageaws) |  | Storage is the AWS storage block: the settings of the root volume, the extra EBS volumes and the instance-local disks. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the AWS block of a storage profile (layer 3). |
| `fake` | [object](#specprofilesstoragefake) |  | Storage is the fake storage block (vendor block and storage profile). |
| `qemu` | [object](#specprofilesstorageqemu) |  | Storage is the qemu storage block (vendor block and storage profile). |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws`

Storage is the AWS storage block: the settings of the root volume, the extra EBS volumes and the instance-local disks. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the AWS block of a storage profile (layer 3).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specprofilesstorageawsdata) |  | data lists extra EBS volumes created with the instance. At most 8 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specprofilesstorageawslocalstorage) |  | localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them. |
| `root` | [object](#specprofilesstorageawsroot) |  | root configures the root EBS volume. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.data[]`

DataVolume is an extra EBS volume: EBS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` (required) | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the volume, e.g. 500Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.localStorage`

localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.root`

root configures the root EBS volume.

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!has(self.volumeType) \|\| !(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption; the account's default EBS key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the root volume, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. Built-in default gp3. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.qemu.data[]`

DataDisk is an extra disk image.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `format` | string |  | format of the disk image. One of `qcow2`, `raw`. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk image. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.qemu.root`

root configures the root disk.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | string |  | format of the overlay image. One of `qcow2`, `raw`. |
| `size` | integer or string |  | size the root image is grown to. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.selections.*`

Selection is a selection profile: sc-karpenter-nodepool's selector and ranking, verbatim. At least one of them is set.

Validation: set selector, ranking or both (`has(self.selector) \|\| has(self.ranking)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ranking` | [object](#specselectionsranking) |  | ranking keeps the best families of the candidates. |
| `selector` | [object](#specselectionsselector) |  | selector filters instance types by Spare Cores data. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking`

ranking keeps the best families of the candidates.

Validation: ranking needs band or families.max (`has(self.band) \|\| (has(self.families) && has(self.families.max))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `band` | [object](#specselectionsrankingband) |  | band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's. |
| `families` | [object](#specselectionsrankingfamilies) |  | families bounds the number of kept families. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize is applied to the score before the objective. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`. |
| `objective` | string | `"Score"` | objective is what the ranking optimises. One of `Score`, `ScorePerPrice`, `Price`. |
| `score` (required) | [object](#specselectionsrankingscore) |  | score is what to rank by. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.band`

band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `withinPercent` (required) | number |  | withinPercent: keep families within this percentage of the best. Minimum 0. Maximum 100. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.families`

families bounds the number of kept families.

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | integer (int32) |  | max keeps at most this many families, even if more are inside the band. Minimum 1. |
| `min` | integer (int32) | `1` | min widens the band until at least this many families are kept (the capacity floor). Minimum 1. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.score`

score is what to rank by.

Validation: set exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile (`has(self.benchmark) != has(self.workloadProfile)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `benchmark` | [object](#specselectionsrankingscorebenchmark) |  | BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark. |
| `workloadProfile` | string |  | WorkloadProfileName is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.score.benchmark`

BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector`

selector filters instance types by Spare Cores data.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accelerator` | [object](#specselectionsselectoraccelerator) |  | AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators"). |
| `architectures` | array of string |  | architectures restricts the CPU architecture; intersected with a kubernetes.io/arch requirement of the template. One of `amd64`, `arm64`. At most 2 items. |
| `benchmarks` | array of [object](#specselectionsselectorbenchmarks) |  | benchmarks are filters on benchmark scores; entries are AND-ed. At most 32 items. |
| `cpu` | [object](#specselectionsselectorcpu) |  | CPUSelector selects on CPU facts. |
| `families` | [object](#specselectionsselectorfamilies) |  | families include/exclude globs on the Spare Cores family string. |
| `instanceTypes` | [object](#specselectionsselectorinstancetypes) |  | instanceTypes include/exclude globs on the instance type name (server.api_reference). |
| `memory` | [object](#specselectionsselectormemory) |  | MemorySelector selects on memory size, in GiB. |
| `network` | [object](#specselectionsselectornetwork) |  | NetworkSelector selects on network bandwidth. Setting a field excludes every type without a value. |
| `price` | [object](#specselectionsselectorprice) |  | PriceSelector selects on the hourly price in USD. |
| `storage` | [object](#specselectionsselectorstorage) |  | StorageSelector selects on instance-local storage. |
| `unbenchmarked` | string | `"Exclude"` | unbenchmarked decides what happens to candidates that lack a score needed by a benchmark filter, workload profile or the ranking score. One of `Exclude`, `IncludeIfFamilyQualifies`, `Include`. |
| `vcpus` | [object](#specselectionsselectorvcpus) |  | vcpus are inclusive bounds on the vCPU count. |
| `workloadProfiles` | array of [object](#specselectionsselectorworkloadprofiles) |  | workloadProfiles are filters on the compound workload benchmarks; entries are AND-ed with the benchmarks. At most 8 items. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector.accelerator`

AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators").

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | [object](#specselectionsselectoracceleratorcount) |  | count is inclusive and may be fractional (vGPU slices). max: 0 selects servers without any accelerator. |

| `memoryPerDevice` | [object](#specselectionsselectoracceleratormemoryperdevice) |  | memoryPerDevice: memory of the smallest accelerator, lower bound. |
| `memoryTotal` | [object](#specselectionsselectoracceleratormemorytotal) |  | memoryTotal: memory summed over all accelerators, lower bound. |
| `models` | array of string |  | models are exact Spare Cores model strings (L40S, A10G, ...); they are not normalised across vendors. At most 64 items. At most 64 characters. |
| `types` | array of string |  | types restricts the type of the primary accelerator. Unknown types are excluded when this is set. One of `GPU`, `TPU`. At most 2 items. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector.accelerator.count`

count is inclusive and may be fractional (vGPU slices). max: 0 selects servers without any accelerator.

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | number |  | Minimum 0. |
| `min` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector.accelerator.memoryPerDevice`

memoryPerDevice: memory of the smallest accelerator, lower bound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minGiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector.accelerator.memoryTotal`

memoryTotal: memory summed over all accelerators, lower bound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

### `spec.selections.*.selector.benchmarks[]`

BenchmarkFilter is one filter on a benchmark score.

Validation: a benchmark entry needs min or max (`has(self.min) \|\| has(self.max)`).

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |
| `max` | number |  | max is an inclusive upper bound, for lower-is-better benchmarks (latencies). |
| `min` | number |  | min is an inclusive lower bound on the (normalised) score, for higher-is-better benchmarks. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize selects the score normalisation. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`, `PerPrice`. |

CPUSelector selects on CPU facts.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `flags` | [object](#specselectionsselectorcpuflags) |  | flags filters on Linux /proc/cpuinfo flag names, lowercase. |
| `hyperthreading` | boolean |  | hyperthreading true selects types with more vCPUs than physical cores (SMT siblings), false selects one vCPU per physical core. Unset: no filter. |
| `manufacturers` | array of string |  | manufacturers are exact, case-sensitive Spare Cores values (Intel, AMD, AWS, Ampere, Alibaba, Microsoft, Hygon). At most 16 items. At most 64 characters. |

caches filters on cache sizes (lower bounds only).

| `l1iPerCoreMinKiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |
| `l2PerCoreMinKiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |
| `l3MinMiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |
| `l3TotalMinMiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

flags filters on Linux /proc/cpuinfo flag names, lowercase.

families include/exclude globs on the Spare Cores family string.

instanceTypes include/exclude globs on the instance type name (server.api_reference).

perVcpu bounds the GiB per vCPU (2 = compute-optimised, 4 = general purpose, 8 = memory-optimised).

|---|---|---|---|
| `maxGiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

PriceSelector selects on the hourly price in USD.

| `maxHourlyPerVcpu` | string |  | maxHourlyPerVcpu is an inclusive upper bound on the hourly price per vCPU in USD, as a decimal string. At most 16 characters. Pattern `^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$`. |

Sysext is an extra systemd sysext installed on every node.

vendors has one block per vendor; a vendor is enabled for this SCNodeClass by having a block.

### `spec.vendors.aws`

aws configures AWS nodes.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `imageOwner` | string |  | imageOwner is the AWS account that owns the Flatcar images. Empty means the official Flatcar account. Pattern `^([0-9]{12})?$`. |
| `instanceProfile` | string |  | instanceProfile is the name of an IAM instance profile attached to the nodes. Empty by default: nodes hold no cloud credentials. At most 128 characters. |
| `metadataOptions` | [object](#specvendorsawsmetadataoptions) |  | metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: IMDSv2 only, hop limit 1. |
| `networking` | [object](#specvendorsawsnetworking) |  | networking overrides the generic spec.networking for AWS. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions is the allow-list of AWS regions; empty means every active region the driver can use. At most 64 items. |
| `resources` | [object](#specvendorsawsresources) |  | resources says how the AWS resources a node depends on are provided. |
| `storage` | [object](#specvendorsawsstorage) |  | storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (gp3, 64 GiB, encrypted root volume; no extra volumes). |

### `spec.vendors.aws.metadataOptions`

metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: IMDSv2 only, hop limit 1.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `httpPutResponseHopLimit` | integer (int32) |  | httpPutResponseHopLimit is the IMDS hop limit; 1 keeps the service out of reach of containers. Built-in default 1. Minimum 1. Maximum 64. |
| `httpTokens` | string |  | httpTokens: required allows IMDSv2 only. Built-in default required. One of `required`, `optional`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking`

networking overrides the generic spec.networking for AWS.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specvendorsawsnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound. |
| `isolation` | string |  | isolation overrides spec.networking.isolation. One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean |  | publicIPv4 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv4. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean |  | publicIPv6 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv6. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking.inbound`

inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specvendorsawsnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.placementGroups`

placementGroups nodes are launched into (see the placement profiles).

Validation: at most one of use, create and forbid may be set (`(has(self.use) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.create) ? 1 : 0) + ((has(self.forbid) && self.forbid) ? 1 : 0) <= 1`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroupscreate) |  | create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle. |
| `forbid` | boolean |  | forbid opts the kind out of auto-creation: offerings that need it are unavailable unless the vendor's default resource exists. |
| `use` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroupsuse) |  | use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.placementGroups.create`

create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifecycle` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroupscreatelifecycle) |  | lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3). |
| `timing` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroupscreatetiming) |  | timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.placementGroups.create.lifecycle`

lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3).

Validation: ttl is only valid with policy idleTTL (`self.policy == 'idleTTL' \|\| !has(self.ttl)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy is perUse, idleTTL or retain. One of `perUse`, `idleTTL`, `retain`. |
| `ttl` | string |  | ttl is how long an unused resource is kept (policy idleTTL). Default 24h, or the controller's --resource-default-ttl. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.placementGroups.create.timing`

timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `"onDemand"` | mode: onDemand creates the resource when the first launch needs it; preCreate creates it in the listed regions right away and keeps it. One of `onDemand`, `preCreate`. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions are the regions to create the resource in (mode preCreate). At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.placementGroups.use`

use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted.

Validation: set exactly one of ids, name and selector (`(has(self.ids) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.name) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.selector) ? 1 : 0) == 1`).

| `ids` | map of array values |  | ids lists the vendor IDs explicitly, per region. |
| `name` | string |  | name is a name pattern; {region} and {zone} are replaced by the region and zone in scope. At most 255 characters. |
| `selector` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroupsuseselector) |  | selector matches resources by tags (labels, where the vendor has no tags), evaluated in every region in scope. |

selector matches resources by tags (labels, where the vendor has no tags), evaluated in every region in scope.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `tags` (required) | map of string values |  | tags must all be present with the given values on the resource. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage`

storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (gp3, 64 GiB, encrypted root volume; no extra volumes).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specvendorsawsstoragedata) |  | data lists extra EBS volumes created with the instance. At most 8 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specvendorsawsstoragelocalstorage) |  | localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them. |
| `root` | [object](#specvendorsawsstorageroot) |  | root configures the root EBS volume. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.data[]`

DataVolume is an extra EBS volume: EBS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` (required) | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the volume, e.g. 500Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.localStorage`

localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.root`

root configures the root EBS volume.

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!has(self.volumeType) \|\| !(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption; the account's default EBS key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the root volume, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. Built-in default gp3. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.vendors.fake.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

| `format` | string |  | format of the disk image. One of `qcow2`, `raw`. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk image. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.vendors.qemu.storage.root`

root configures the root disk.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | string |  | format of the overlay image. One of `qcow2`, `raw`. |
| `size` | integer or string |  | size the root image is grown to. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

## status

### `status`

SCNodeClassStatus is the observed state of an SCNodeClass.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | array of [object](#statusconditions) |  | conditions of the SCNodeClass: Ready, CatalogReady, ArtifactsReady, ValidationSucceeded, and RestartRequired when set. |
| `resolved` | [object](#statusresolved) |  | resolved holds the artifacts resolved for the whole SCNodeClass. |
| `vendorNames` | array of string |  | vendorNames lists the vendors that have a block in the spec, for the printer column. |
| `vendors` | map of [object](#statusvendors) |  | vendors is the observed state per vendor. |

### `status.conditions[]`

Condition aliases the upstream type and adds additional helper methods

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lastTransitionTime` (required) | string (date-time) |  | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `message` (required) | string |  | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. At most 32768 characters. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. Minimum 0. |
| `reason` (required) | string |  | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. At most 1024 characters. Pattern `^[A-Za-z]([A-Za-z0-9_,:]*[A-Za-z0-9_])?$`. |
| `status` (required) | string |  | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `type` (required) | string |  | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. At most 316 characters. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?(([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9])$`. |

### `status.resolved`

resolved holds the artifacts resolved for the whole SCNodeClass.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kubernetes` | map of [object](#statusresolvedkubernetes) |  | kubernetes is the Kubernetes sysext per architecture. |
| `tailscale` | map of [object](#statusresolvedtailscale) |  | tailscale is the Tailscale sysext per architecture. |

### `status.resolved.kubernetes.*`

Artifact is a downloadable image pinned by its checksum.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sha256` (required) | string |  | sha256 of the image, lower-case hex. |
| `url` (required) | string |  | url the image is downloaded from. |

### `status.resolved.tailscale.*`

Artifact is a downloadable image pinned by its checksum.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sha256` (required) | string |  | sha256 of the image, lower-case hex. |
| `url` (required) | string |  | url the image is downloaded from. |

### `status.vendors.*`

VendorStatus is the observed state of one vendor of the SCNodeClass.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | array of [object](#statusvendorsconditions) |  | conditions of the vendor: VendorReady, ImagesReady, ResourcesReady, QuotaAvailable. |
| `hash` | string |  | hash is the drift hash of the shared fields that change what a node is plus this vendor's block (overview section 6.3). |
| `images` | array of [object](#statusvendorsimages) |  | images are the resolved boot images per region and architecture. |
| `quota` | array of [object](#statusvendorsquota) |  | quota is the quota view per region and capacity type. |
| `resources` | array of [object](#statusvendorsresources) |  | resources are the vendor resources referenced or managed, per region. |

### `status.vendors.*.conditions[]`

Condition aliases the upstream type and adds additional helper methods

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lastTransitionTime` (required) | string (date-time) |  | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `message` (required) | string |  | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. At most 32768 characters. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. Minimum 0. |
| `reason` (required) | string |  | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. At most 1024 characters. Pattern `^[A-Za-z]([A-Za-z0-9_,:]*[A-Za-z0-9_])?$`. |
| `status` (required) | string |  | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `type` (required) | string |  | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. At most 316 characters. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?(([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9])$`. |

### `status.vendors.*.images[]`

ImageStatus is the boot image of a region and architecture.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arch` (required) | string |  | arch is amd64 or arm64. |
| `message` | string |  | message explains an image that is not ready. |
| `ready` (required) | boolean |  | ready says whether the image can be launched in the region. |
| `ref` (required) | string |  | ref is the vendor's image reference (for example an AMI ID). |
| `region` (required) | string |  |  |

### `status.vendors.*.quota[]`

QuotaStatus is the quota view of one bucket.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bucket` (required) | string |  | bucket is the vendor's quota identifier. |
| `capacityType` (required) | string |  | capacityType is on-demand or spot. |
| `limit` (required) | integer (int64) |  | limit is the bucket's limit in the same unit. |
| `reason` | string |  | reason is set when the bucket has no headroom, for example QuotaExhausted. |
| `region` (required) | string |  |  |
| `used` (required) | integer (int64) |  | used is the current consumption in the bucket's unit. |

### `status.vendors.*.resources[]`

ResourceStatus is a vendor resource referenced (use) or managed (create).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` (required) | string |  | id of the resource at the vendor. |
| `kind` (required) | string |  | kind of the resource, for example subnets. |
| `lastUsed` | string (date-time) |  | lastUsed is when an instance last used a managed resource. |
| `managed` | boolean |  | managed is true for resources SCarpenter created. |
| `message` | string |  | message explains a resource that is not ready or cannot be deleted. |
| `region` (required) | string |  |  |
